description: Create a PayPal (sandbox) payment for the checkout's exact total. Returns approve_url: give that link to the user and ask them to approve the payment on PayPal — you cannot approve it yourself. Then call wait_for_payment_approval.

api_key.description: Sandbox key from create_checkout (not needed if the connection already carries one).

name: request_paypal_payment
title: Ask the user to pay with PayPal
